overview: Paisa Hi Paisa is a fun coin-earning web app where you spin a wheel, answer quizzes, and do daily check-ins to earn coins — then cash them out via bank transfer.
features: Spin Wheel — 70 daily spins, 50–100 coins each
Daily Quiz — new questions every day, 10–30 coins per correct answer
Coin Dashboard — balance, earning history, and Paisa Hi Paisa branding
Withdrawal System — submit bank details (account number, IFSC, name), 100 coins = 10 INR
